name: SiteImageViewer
intent: A background site-plan image (aerial / blueprint) with a villa polygon overlay coloured by construction progress. A plain SVG whose viewBox equals the image's natural pixel size sits over an , so image-pixel villa points map 1:1 to the screen (no canvas library, no coordinate math). Villas colour by approved % across the milestone ramp; unlinked render grey, linked-but-no-progress render slate. Hovering a linked villa raises its stroke + name chip inline (no modal); the floating Approved-vs-Planned progress card (the DS ProgressComparison) is opt-in via the `hoverCard` prop and off by default. A built-in legend (bottom-right) keys the colours and doubles as the SPA (progress) ↔ Construction (variance) mode switch: a segmented toggle, a header, the colour ramp laid out horizontally with a label under each bucket, and the non-ramp states as footnotes.
when: Overlay real footprint polygons on a site aerial / blueprint, coloured by progress
Let a user hover a footprint to read its approved-vs-planned progress
Switch a site map between progress (SPA) and variance (Construction) colouring
whenNot: A tiled, pan/zoom geospatial map -> use the Map / ObservationsMap widgets
A choropleth of abstract plot boxes (no real footprints/aerial) -> a simple grid
A single floor's blueprint plan -> use the BlueprintViewer template

chooseOver.because: Those are tiled geospatial map engines. SiteImageViewer is a lightweight pure-SVG overlay on a fixed site image — the viewBox equals the image size, so villa points need no projection.

chooseOver.component: Hand-rolling an SVG overlay + a hover card + a legend
chooseOver.because: SiteImageViewer owns the 1:1 viewBox mapping, the milestone/variance colour resolver shared across fill + hover card + legend, the flip-and-clamp floating ProgressComparison card, and the built-in legend/mode switch.

regions.role: The background site-plan image (backgroundUrl); fills the frame by default (imageFit=cover), or letterboxes with imageFit=contain
SVG polygon overlay — one polygon per villa, coloured by styleForVilla; linked villas are interactive
regions.source: raw <svg> with viewBox = image pixel size

regions.role: Opt-in floating Approved-vs-Planned progress card while hovering a linked villa (hoverCard prop, off by default — hover is otherwise inline: raised stroke + name chip)

Bottom-right key that doubles as the SPA/Construction mode switch — a segmented toggle, a header, the colour ramp with a label under each bucket, and the non-ramp states as footnotes. Collapsible; collapsed by default to a small 'Legend' pill

Top-right zoom controls (zoom in / out / reset); the map also supports wheel-to-zoom (toward the cursor) and drag-to-pan once zoomed. Zooming out past fill centres the image on a dark-grey backdrop; Reset returns to fill
regions.source: Button (icon) cluster over a CSS-transform pan/zoom layer

requiredComponents.name: Button
requiredComponents.note: The icon buttons for zoom in / out / reset.

backgroundUrl.note: The site image; hosted by the consumer.

villas.note: Footprints in image-pixel space; each has points, a bbox, linkedLbsItemId, and approved/planned %. The real ROSHN Almanar set is @corensystem/coren-ui/site-image-viewer-fixtures.

imageFit.note: How the image fits the frame; cover (fills) by default, contain letterboxes. The SVG overlay slices/meets to match.

mapMode.note: Colour mode. Controlled when onMapModeChange is given; else the initial mode. Default progress.

onMapModeChange.note: Fired when the mode changes; provide to control mapMode from outside (e.g. share with a side panel).

hoverCard.note: Opt in to the floating ProgressComparison hover card; off by default (hover is inline only).

labelSize.note: On-screen px size of the villa-number labels; held constant regardless of fit scale (the viewer counter-scales the SVG text). Default 10.

onNavigate.note: Fired when a linked villa is clicked.

dataContract.note: The colour ramp and viewBox size come from props/defaults; the villa data is not bundled with the widget.

states.progress: SPA mode — villas coloured by approved % across the M35–M100 ramp.
states.variance: Construction mode — villas coloured behind / on-track / ahead of plan (±2.5%).
states.hover: A hovered linked villa raises its stroke + name chip (inline); with `hoverCard`, also shows the floating progress card.
states.unlinked: Villas with no linkedLbsItemId render grey and are non-interactive.
states.missing: Linked villas with no approved % render slate.
states.zoomed: Zoomed in via the top-right tools / wheel; drag to pan. Villa numbers stay a constant on-screen size; Reset returns to fit.

responsive.strategy: Fills its container; the SVG overlay + image scale together (viewBox + matching object-fit — cover by default) so footprints stay registered at any size.

allowedPlacement: the map/canvas pane of a site workspace (e.g. the CaptureUiEnhanced template)
forbiddenPlacement: inside a small card (needs room for the site image + hover card)

commonMistakes.mistake: Recomputing villa screen coordinates by hand
commonMistakes.symptom: Polygons drift off the image at some sizes
commonMistakes.fix: Keep the viewBox equal to the image's natural pixel size (imageWidth/imageHeight) and let the browser map points 1:1.

commonMistakes.mistake: Colouring the polygons and the legend from different ramps
commonMistakes.fix: Both read the exported milestone ramp (styleForVilla / PROGRESS_LEGEND_ITEMS / VARIANCE_LEGEND_ITEMS).

commonMistakes.mistake: Bundling the villa data with the widget
commonMistakes.symptom: Every consumer pulls the ~large fixture payload
commonMistakes.fix: Pass villas via props; import the demo set from @corensystem/coren-ui/site-image-viewer-fixtures only in demo surfaces.

evaluationCriteria.check: Renders the site image, the SVG villa overlay, and the built-in legend.
The SVG viewBox equals imageWidth×imageHeight so footprints register on the image.
Hovering a linked villa raises its stroke + name chip inline; no floating card unless hoverCard is set.
The legend switches SPA (progress) ↔ Construction (variance) colouring.
